newsitem.title: FRANCE: French PM Jospin to attend EU Amsterdam summit.
newsitem.headline: French PM Jospin to attend EU Amsterdam summit.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin will attend the European Union Amsterdam summit on June 16 and 17 and this would not create problems with French President Jacques Chirac, an official in Jospin's office said on Friday.
He said Jospin's presence at the summit would not create "any difficulties" with Chirac.
Under French constitutional prerogatives the President has a big say in the key areas of foreign affairs and defence.
Socialist Jospin swept to power in a parliamentary election on June 1, ousting the centre-right coalition, producing what is called in France a "cohabitation" with the centre-right President Chirac.
